title: EAST: mixed events with medium traffic
objective: Work Budapest EAST with medium traffic through weather, a radio failure and unplanned traffic.
challenges: Weather on the flow to and from the Romanian border
A silent aircraft on its last clearance
criteria: No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)
Traffic kept 5 NM / 1000 ft from the 7600 aircraft
Every request and coordination answered within 60 s
Every flight transferred at its agreed exit level

injects.text: A flight asks for a higher cruising level.
A CB builds on the main flow. Expect deviation requests.
injects.objective: Every deviation request answered before the aircraft deviates on its own (10 min)

injects.text: An aircraft stops answering and squawks 7600. It keeps its last clearance.
injects.objective: No aircraft within 5 NM / 1000 ft of the 7600 track while it is silent

injects.text: The next sector asks for another exit level.
injects.objective: Answered within 60 s, and the aircraft leaves at the agreed level
No STCA involving it in its first 3 min
